# Awaiting Author Response Saved Replies

## Waiting for Author

**Use case**: PR feedback or change requests are pending a response from the original author.

```markdown
Hi @username,

We're awaiting your response on the requested changes or feedback for this PR.

**Next steps:**

- Please review and address the requested changes or questions above.
- If you need guidance, reply here and a maintainer will assist you.

If there is no response within 14 days, this PR may be closed to keep the backlog healthy. You can always re-open or resubmit when ready!
```
